[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Obigon''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and commander of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigate]] ''[[Null Space]]''. He surrendered his ship to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s to avoid being [[Death/Legends|killed]].
